scripts.test: vitest run --config frontend/vite.config.ts && node --test tests/contracts.test.mjs && cargo test --quiet
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && rm -f target/stock-promise-e2e.db target/stock-promise-e2e.db-shm target/stock-promise-e2e.db-wal && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:hosted: VITE_HOSTED_AUTH_FIXTURE=1 npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.hosted-auth.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:hosted
